description: Receipt replay identity in v1.2 fingerprinted the full non-transport receipt structure. A second receipt with the same targetRef, clauseRef, canonical GUT identity, canonical provenance and triage classification but a changed summary or other decorative field could therefore qualify as a second receipt and inflate qualifyingReceiptCount/aliasAudit without adding a new metabolic diagnosis.
resolution: v1.3 deduplicates qualifying GUT triage receipts by bounded diagnostic identity: targetRef + clauseRef + canonical organ + canonical provenance + triage classification. Structural receipt fingerprints remain available for audit, while the same provenance with a genuinely different classification remains a conflict and is not suppressed as replay.
promotion: Eligible after CI success; public display may advance to dynamic decomposition v1.3 without implying source truth, capability installation, persistent assimilation or autonomous morphogenesis.
privacy: Synthetic/de-identified evidence only; no private connector identifiers or source text.
